title: docs(adr): record the #28971 ruling at ADR-0131 D13 and in ADR-0017 — named personal views are a user-owned data object
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed by the record-page epic seat as an execution step of the ruling on #28971. The maintainer answered 「同意」 (2026-11-02) to the seat's recommendation of option C. Readings are on `main` `ab085a0482`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

This is a dated note only. It changes `docs/adr/**`, so it follows the governed-surface path and waits for a maintainer approval.

## Reading

- `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`, D13 (around line 909): "a per-user 'personal view' scope stays the parked v18 direction … if pulled, it returns as a user-owned D3 object, not as this table."
- `docs/adr/0017-object-has-many-view.md`, line 71: the `personal` layer, "visible only to its `owner`". This ADR carries the amendment note.

## Target

Add one dated note at each place, citing #28971, saying:

- Named personal views are a user-owned D3 object, as D13 anticipated. The direction is ruled, no longer parked.
- They are not view items, and they do not reuse `scope: 'personal'`.
- The first version follows #28949, #28948, #28950 and #28912.

Do not rewrite the ADRs' existing text.

## Acceptance

Both notes are present and cite #28971, and no other text in either ADR changes.
